title: CSP Policy Plan
description: A structured plan for a Content-Security-Policy deployment, so the strict-CSP baseline and this skill's Quality Gates can be checked deterministically by scripts/csp_policy_audit.mjs.

scriptSrcStrategy.description: How script-src admits scripts: per-response nonce, build-time sha256 hash, an origin allowlist (legacy), or 'unsafe-inline' (defeats CSP).

deploymentMode.description: Whether the policy ships as Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only (phase 1) or the enforcing Content-Security-Policy header (phase 2).

htmlGeneration.description: Whether HTML is rendered per request (nonce-friendly) or statically generated/cached (requires hashes).

strictDynamic.description: True if script-src includes 'strict-dynamic' so nonce/hash-trusted scripts may load further scripts transitively.

objectSrcNone.description: True if the policy sets object-src 'none'.

baseUriNone.description: True if the policy sets base-uri 'none'.

usesUnsafeEval.description: True if the policy includes 'unsafe-eval' in script-src.

wildcardInScriptSrc.description: True if script-src contains a bare wildcard (*).

nonceEntropyBits.description: Bits of entropy in the generated nonce; the minimum acceptable is 128.

nonceFreshPerResponse.description: True if a new nonce is generated for every HTTP response (not at startup or per route).

nonceInjection.description: How nonces reach <script> tags: emitted at known template points (safe), or stamped onto all script tags by an HTML-rewriting middleware (unsafe — attacker-injected tags get the nonce too).

reportOnlyDays.description: How many days the identical policy ran under Content-Security-Policy-Report-Only before (or instead of) enforcement; the gate is >= 7.

reportToConfigured.description: True if the report-to directive plus a Reporting-Endpoints header are configured.

reportUriConfigured.description: True if the legacy report-uri directive is configured for older browsers.

frameAncestorsViaMetaOnly.description: True if frame-ancestors is only declared inside a <meta http-equiv> tag, where CSP3 says it is silently ignored.

legacyHeadersRemoved.description: True if obsolete X-Content-Security-Policy / X-WebKit-CSP headers have been removed.
